label_audit.scope: Separately coded action/state formulas for the ten collected families; no engine/measure imports
limits: One trial cannot establish test-retest reliability
Inspect is a request for already-public information, not demonstrated information gain
Execution and rule labels are operational, not evidence of discovery or intent

structured_omissions: Current state and observed history (available separately in action messages)
representation.conclusion: Static inputs can support probabilistic episode forecasts, but structured fields alone are not a complete simulator specification. Text alone deliberately aliases patched and unpatched games; include experimental control metadata for an informed observer, and exact pre-action messages for next-action prediction.
